Naruto Themed Motorcycle Decals – Kawasaki Ninja 400

When it comes to what you can do with a couple of custom-designed vehicle decals, the possibilities are truly limitless. Vinyl Wrap Toronto is an established Vehicle Wrapping Agency in Toronto. Over the years, we’ve wrapped vehicles and installed decals for countless of our customers. With all that work, we’ve seen a lot of designs and new ideas. In most cases, our clients impress us with their creative vision and out-of-the-box thinking.

Recently we had the pleasure of installing decals on a Kawasaki Ninja 400. The reason and inspiration behind this particular job are practical and goes on to show that you can turn your motorcycle into your fantasy bike. The client had laid down his motorcycle a couple of times and it resulted in the bike getting a couple of scratches. So, here’s the interesting part. The customer could have easily gotten rid of those scratches by any other means, but he chose to handle it in a way that would give him his fantasy motorcycle. He wanted several cloud-shaped decals all over his motorcycle along with some symbols on the head and tail.

The decals were inspired by a Japanese Anime Series, Naruto and clearly, the client was a big fan. He contacted our team and explained what he wanted. Our designers didn’t take long to create a mockup of the design showing what it would look like on the Kawasaki Ninja 400 and the client approved it. With his approval, we began the print and lamination process.

Although installing decals is generally easier than doing a full or partial wrap, but it can get tricky when you have a lot of decals that need to be aligned perfectly with each other. That’s where our installers’ experience comes in handy. The decals were installed with absolute precision and the client’s reaction when he saw the final product, proved it. We’ve attached some pictures of the Kawasaki Ninja 400 on this page for you to see how motorcycle decals can change the look of your bike.

To help you make a decision, here are some of the reasons why you should consider decals for your vehicle.

  1. Motorcycle decals are a cost-effective way to freshen up the look of your bike.
  2. Vehicle Decals are easy to install and remove (by professionals).
  3. You get to pick any colour, size, shape, and finish you want the vehicle decals to be.
  4. Decals are a great and non-aggressive way to advertise your business.
  5. Vehicle decals will last for years before you’ll have to think about replacing them.
  6. Along with having a long lifespan, decals require minimum maintenance.

So, if you’ve got a motorcycle or vehicle in need of a makeover, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to offer its services. For any queries or to get a quote, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.
